digest.component_or_area: LLM model configuration and class resolution
propositions: rebar needs a way to express which model applies to each capability tier (frontier, standard, trivial) via three config slots
the class configuration schema must parse from layered config (CLI > env > config file > default) with per-field env vars for each tier and slot attribute
a fallback array on each slot parses and is carried on the resolved record but is not consumed at runtime
the resolver maps class name to provider-qualified model string, reusing infer_provider when provider is omitted
secrets boundaries must be enforced: api_key is forbidden in both class slots and fallback entries, mirroring the existing no-secrets-in-config-file rule
a named load_class_slots() entry point must make the schema reachable from real configuration by reading the model_classes sub-table from the merged [tool.rebar.llm] config
